svg.title: RT-DETR 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何形成候選與會交出什麼 box evidence；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 比 query／candidate 與 box 輸出

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 偵測模型的取捨來自候選如何形成、哪些框被保留，以及輸出如何回到原始 ROI 與 review。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-semantic-relation: use declared queries to select candidate boxes
g.data-must-show: RT-DETR：依據：hybrid encoder 融合的多尺度 features、selected object queries/reference points 與 set labels | candidate output: 可用輸出：指定 decoder depth 的 class/box set，經完整 runtime/P95/recall gate | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: RT-DETR output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: RT-DETR：依據：hybrid encoder 融合的多尺度 features、selected object queries/reference points 與 set labels

g.data-not-claim: YOLO dense detector output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
